# Sourpuss

> Find and rate the best whisky sours in your city

Find and rate the best whisky sours in your city. A community for discerning sippers.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sourpuss.app/): Main landing page with app features and download link
- [Privacy Policy](https://sourpuss.app/privacy): How we collect, use, and protect user data
- [Support](https://sourpuss.app/support): FAQs and contact information

## Key Features

- Find Bars: Discover cocktail bars near you with real ratings from fellow enthusiasts
- Rate & Review: Share your cocktail experiences with the community
- Leaderboards: See the top-rated bars and most active reviewers in your area
- Save Favorites: Bookmark the bars you love or want to visit

## Contact

- Email: support@sourpuss.app
- Website: https://sourpuss.app
